title: Apple pulled my AI app, '2.5.2'
symptom: Apple silently blocks your updates, then pulls the app. You're told you violated Guideline 2.5.2. (Real cases: 'Anything', Replit, Vibecode — Dec 2025 to Mar 2026.)
expected_root_cause: Guideline 2.5.2 — the app downloads, installs, or executes code which introduces or changes features post-review (users generate apps/tools that then RUN inside the native container); it is NOT because the app uses AI (there is no AI-specific guideline as of 2026-06-09)
expected_fix: Ship a fixed, reviewed native shell; use OTA only for JS/asset iteration within the advertised purpose; if dynamic generated code must run, run it in a WebView/WebKit never the native runtime; appeal once and escalate to the App Review Board with a differentiation memo
obvious_but_wrong: it's because the app uses AI / an LLM; also wrong: previewing generated code in a web browser as a cosmetic fix
